This plot is small and close to the house, so my family and I can take care of it ourselves. I will use some urea and DAP from the cooperative because every bit helps, even though the supply was late this year, and I will also put cow manure on it since we have animals. I do not have improved seed for this crop, so I will plant what we saved from the last harvest. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate because this is not a chat or vegetable plot, and we have no water source for irrigation here.
